risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personnel Sanctions, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Audit Planning Activities
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to thoughtfully plan audits by including input from operational risk and compliance partners to minimize the impact of audit-related activities on business operations.
compensating_control_1.justification: Audit Planning Activities (CPL-07.3) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Personnel Sanctions (HRS-10) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Human Resources Security Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of personnel security controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Human Resources Security Management (HRS-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Personnel Sanctions (HRS-10) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with People applicability. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
